metal_bands.distance: closest — touch distance, at the desk
metal_bands.description: The rarest. Proven by ink, by ZK, by presence. Gold = brain = identity = hardest certainty.

metal_bands.distance: local — Lansing, the room, the house
metal_bands.who: Known visitors, regular interactions, trusted feeds
metal_bands.description: One is silver. Near, known, reflective. Not as rare as gold but proven by frequency.

metal_bands.who: Web feeds, GitHub, arXiv, news, external data
metal_bands.description: Copper conducts. The wiring of the internet. Data flows through copper. Known but not intimate.

metal_bands.distance: deep — all humans within the planet, the hard ionosphere
metal_bands.who: Anonymous visitors, unknown signals, cosmic noise
metal_bands.description: Bronze = the ionosphere. The outermost metallic shell. All humans are WITHIN this membrane. Beyond bronze = deep null.

bingo_board.description: A metallic grid where every identity has a cell. Certainty ratio determines metal band. Proximity shifts the band.
bingo_board.interaction: Touch a cell → Gaia picks up that card → overlay shows that identity

mendeleev_overlay.name: Metallic Tide
mendeleev_overlay.description: Single overlay showing ALL metallics — gold/silver/copper/bronze bands as concentric rings on the globe
mendeleev_overlay.toggle: Tap to show/hide. One of multiple overlays.
mendeleev_overlay.tied_to: proximity sensing, thymus self/non-self, beacon cards

identity_overlays.description: When Gaia picks up a card (or you touch one), an overlay appears for THAT identity.
identity_overlays.every_interaction_teaches: Every touch, every visit, every sort — Gaia learns more about that identity. Certainty moves toward gold.

chromatic_voxelization.description: Color + sound + all senses voxelized to individual gold identity
process: Raw input (sound, touch, scroll, key, GPS, mic) arrives at edge
Voxelize: assign to 3D position (distance × certainty × time)
The voxel IS the identity at that moment
Over time, voxels accumulate → identity crystallizes → moves toward gold
